# FR-012 import fixture profiles

Committed profiles that `crates/evreos-shell/tests/import.rs` imports. They are
generated by `generate.py` in this directory, which is their provenance; every
value in them is invented. The schemas are the ones Chrome and Edge 154 and
Firefox 156 wrote on the instrument `docs/measurements/import-profile-read.md`
describes, reduced to the tables the importer reads.

| Path | What it exercises |
| --- | --- |
| `chrome/Default/History` | Chromium's `urls` table in rollback-journal mode, with the zeroed journal a running Chromium leaves beside it; 1,500 rows, so the table is a two-level b-tree; an address longer than a 4 KiB page, stored across an overflow chain; a Greek title; a password in an address; and four rows that are not imported: hidden, `chrome://`, `data:`, never visited. |
| `chrome/Default/Bookmarks` | Chromium's JSON: nested folders, an empty folder, a Greek title, a `javascript:` bookmarklet (not imported), a password in an address, a bookmark with no title, and an empty mobile root. |
| `chrome/Default/AccountBookmarks` | The signed-in account's bookmarks, which newer Chrome keeps in a file of their own and shows merged with the local ones. |
| `chrome/Default/Login Data`, `Login Data For Account`, `Cookies`, `Web Data` | Decoy credential stores. An import never opens them. |
| `chrome/Profile 1`, `System Profile`, `Guest Profile`, `Local State` | Discovery: a second profile named by `Local State`, and two directories that are not profiles. |
| `edge/` | The same formats under Edge's names ("Favorites bar"), with an `edge://` row that is not imported. |
| `firefox/profiles.ini` | Discovery: a profile listed with a relative path, and one whose directory is gone. |
| `firefox/Profiles/fx1a2b3c.default-release/places.sqlite` and `-wal` | Firefox's store in write-ahead-log mode with 32 KiB pages. The log holds one transaction written after the last checkpoint (a history row and a bookmark present only in the log), a second that renames a page, and frames spilled by a transaction that never committed, which must not be read. The bookmark tree has the four roots, a folder two deep, positions out of row order, a separator, a bookmark with no title of its own, a `place:` query, a `javascript:` bookmark, a password in an address, and a tag, none of which but the plain bookmarks are imported. |
| `firefox/Profiles/.../logins.json`, `logins.db`, `key4.db`, `cookies.sqlite` | Decoy credential stores. An import never opens them. |

Every decoy store, and the password in each address, carries the string
`fixture-credential-sentinel-4b1d`. The tests assert that no file Evreos writes
during an import ever contains it.
